Chat streaming against real OpenAI API, verifies chunks received

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"max_tokens\":50,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count from 1 to 5.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chatStream(request)
    println(result.chunks)
}
```
